unlisted_practices: Environment-grounded turn-level rewards from simulator state transitions (patient distress and resistance) for reinforcement learning training of caregiver LLM agents
Independent centered-rank normalization of turn- and trajectory-level rewards to prevent reward collapse

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a reinforcement learning optimization framework (T2-GRPO) with simulated dementia patients. It introduces a training/optimization algorithm rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or operational guardrail.
